 Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Rocky fans break world record on film's 50th anniversary
 More than 500 Rocky fans gathered at the steps of the Philadelphia Museum of Art on 13 November, setting a new world record for the largest gathering of people dressed as Rocky Balboa.
 A minimum of 250 people needed to be there for the occasion, a requirement set by Guinness World Record officials adjudicating the event.
 This year marks the 50th anniversary of the release of the first Rocky film, and officials in Philadelphia have organised a series of events to honour the fictional underdog boxer.
